officialSeasonSource.evidence: HEAD 26/27 Hardgoods Workbook lists article 313366 as Worldcup Rebels e.SLR, lengths 149/156/163/170 cm, reference sidecut 123/66/107 mm and radius 11.2 m at 163 cm, LYT PR Base, and binding 100911 PR 11 GW Brake [G] 78 mm. The previous-season product article is 313365 and is kept in a separate seed.

officialProductPage.evidence: HEAD Slovenia official product page is for article 313366.SET, gives a final price of EUR 730, lists 149/156/163/170 cm, advanced skill level and on-piste terrain. The selected 149 cm geometry is 123/66/107 mm with 9.2 m radius. PR 11 GW is the standard binding option and Protector EVO PR 11 GW is shown with a EUR 50 surcharge. The page displays weight 1995 g but does not specify single ski/pair or binding inclusion, so weight basis remains unresolved.

officialFeaturesRecheck20261015.evidence: HEAD 官方商品页明确描述 full woodcore、metal、减振 EMC，列 Graphene 与 titanal layers，并列 Advanced/On Piste/Fast/Short Radius/Rebel Camber。页面当前选中 149 cm 时显示 camber 100%、tip/tail rocker 0%。
officialFeaturesRecheck20261015.decision: 补齐型号级芯材、结构、技术和定位；板型百分比只记录页面当前选中的 149 cm，不延伸到其他长度。重量 1995 g 仍因口径不明而不录入。

exactSeasonSizeTable.evidence: Skitreff identifies a 2026/27 HEAD Worldcup Rebels e.SLR set and lists all four exact-length geometry rows. regionalRetailerReference.decision: Retain as a Korean regional listed-price reference only.
